You will build on the structure that already exists.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p><strong>Agency &amp; Channel Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full relationship with every outsourced sales partner across countries: onboarding, day-to-day management, escalations and offboarding</li> <li>Be the single point of accountability for agency sales results, replacing today's fragmented oversight</li> <li>Negotiate and manage contracts, SLAs and commercial terms, including pay-for-performance structures</li> <li>Evaluate, select and onboard new sales agencies as we enter new markets</li> <li>Build one operating framework (reporting cadence, WBRs, MBRs, escalation paths) that works the same way across agencies, channels and countries</li> </ul> <p><strong>Performance Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and track sales KPIs and SLAs per agency, channel and market: conversion, signed locations per rep, productivity, lead quality and adherence to the Vinted Go pitch</li> <li>Build and maintain dashboards that give real-time visibility into performance across the whole network</li> <li>Spot underperforming agencies or markets early and drive corrective action plans</li> <li>Translate acquisition targets set by leadership into agency-level performance expectations</li> <li>Run calibration and quality assurance (call reviews, field ride-alongs) so every agency sells consistently</li> </ul> <p><strong>Budget Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the outsourced sales budget across all agencies and countries: forecasting, spend tracking and variance reporting</li> <li>Analyze cost per outcome (CAC, cost per signed location, cost per hour) across agencies, channels and markets to drive efficiency</li> <li>Find and execute cost optimizations
